user.title: Connect to CodexBar
user.description: Point Home Assistant at your running `codexbar serve` instance.

data_description.host: Base URL of `codexbar serve`, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080
data_description.token: The value of CODEXBAR_DASHBOARD_TOKEN (bare token or `Bearer ...`)

create_entry.default:
CodexBar is connected.

Use this webhook URL as the destination for CodexBar hook rules:

Treat this URL as a password. You can view it again from the integration's Configure dialog.
